name: Seven Eighty Three
description: Seven Eighty Three, known as Lab 783, is an independent think tank, systems laboratory, and venture foundry built from the mulch up. We apply principles of engineered nature (carrying capacity, closed-loop energy transfer, and self-regulating feedback loops) to construct physical supply chains, sovereign digital environments, and organizational infrastructure. Our practice operates across three core pillars: High-Density Diagnostics, Workflow & Systems Architecture, and Sovereign Infrastructure Design.

contact.intake_behavior: Three required fields: name, system objective, and current architecture. Drafts an email to hello@seveneightythree.com in the visitor’s email app; nothing is sent until the visitor sends it.

services.name: High-Density Diagnostics
services.description: A high-density audit of how your organization actually runs, across code, text, physical space, and behavior. Every engagement starts here.

services.name: Workflow & Systems Architecture
services.description: Applying carrying capacity, closed-loop energy transfer, and self-regulating feedback loops to physical supply chains and organizational infrastructure.

services.name: Sovereign Infrastructure Design
services.description: Sovereign digital environments built on the Universe API, which works below the query layer to govern AI and search engine indexing.

wild_lake.role: Wild-Lake keeps the method honest. Wild Lake Studio is a brutalist talent architecture and structural design studio. It scouts raw creative capability and builds systems around it, across songs, scripts, and major bodies of work. It formalizes a fifteen-year independent practice of guiding developing artists. Created within Lab 783 as its research laboratory, Wild-Lake is the home of the Talent Architecture practice: advisory on a retainer or fixed project fee, covering artist development, A&R, and creative infrastructure. It takes no ownership or percentage of an artist's work. Wild-Lake also partners with record labels, galleries, and booking agencies. Every engagement begins with the artist's willing participation, whether they approach directly or through a representative.

communal_foundation.description: Communal Foundation is a systems laboratory that pairs hyper-local demographic constraints with chef-driven culinary artistry. Lab 783 built it between September and November 2026, as the foundry's first company. Communal Foundation is available for acquisition as a venture package: brand and domain, site and infrastructure, and operating model and chef-commissioning framework.
